sql_first_line: BEGIN
SELECT doc FROM identity_users WHERE user_id=$1
BEGIN
CREATE TEMP TABLE align_inputs(idx int, id uuid, min_date bigint)
COPY align_inputs FROM STDIN
CREATE TEMP TABLE align_knows AS SELECT DISTINCT e.id FROM align_inputs i JOIN anchors e ON e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND e.arch_type='Knows' AND (e.src=i.id OR e.dst=i.id)

CREATE TEMP TABLE align_friends AS SELECT DISTINCT i.idx,i.min_date,CASE WHEN e.src=i.id THEN e.dst ELSE e.src END AS id FROM align_inputs i JOIN anchors e ON e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND e.arch_type='Knows' AND (e.src=i.id OR e.dst=i.id) JOIN anchors n ON n.id=CASE WHEN e.src=i.id THEN e.dst ELSE e.src END AND n.arch_type='Person'

CREATE TEMP TABLE align_members AS SELECT DISTINCT e.id,e.src AS forum FROM align_friends f JOIN anchors e ON e.dst=f.id AND e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND e.arch_type='HasMember' AND (e.props->'archetype'->>'joinDate')::bigint>f.min_date JOIN anchors n ON n.id=e.src AND n.arch_type='Forum'
CREATE TEMP TABLE align_forums AS SELECT DISTINCT forum AS id FROM align_members
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ON align_forums(id)

CREATE TEMP TABLE align_containers AS SELECT e.id,e.dst AS post FROM align_forums f JOIN anchors e ON e.src=f.id AND e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND e.arch_type='ContainerOf' JOIN anchors n ON n.id=e.dst AND n.arch_type='Post'
CREATE TEMP TABLE align_posts AS SELECT DISTINCT post AS id FROM align_containers
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ON align_posts(id)

CREATE TEMP TABLE align_creators AS SELECT e.id FROM align_posts p JOIN anchors e ON e.src=p.id AND e.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND e.arch_type='HasCreator' JOIN anchors n ON n.id=e.dst AND n.arch_type='Person'
CREATE TEMP TABLE align_edges AS SELECT id FROM align_knows UNION SELECT id FROM align_members UNION SELECT id FROM align_containers UNION SELECT id FROM align_creators
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ON align_edges(id)

CREATE TEMP TABLE align_ids(id uuid PRIMARY KEY); INSERT INTO align_ids SELECT id FROM align_edges UNION SELECT a.src FROM anchors a JOIN align_edges e ON e.id=a.id WHERE a.src IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT a.dst FROM anchors a JOIN align_edges e ON e.id=a.id WHERE a.dst IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT id FROM align_inputs
SELECT doc FROM identity_users WHERE user_id=$1
INSERT INTO align_ids VALUES($1) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO align_ids SELECT DISTINCT a.root_id FROM anchors a JOIN align_ids i ON i.id=a.id WHERE a.root_id IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

COPY (SELECT a.id,a.kind,a.arch_type,a.arch_module,a.fingerprint,a.root_id,a.src,a.dst,a.undirected,a.props::text,a.xmin::text,a.seq,a.src_type,a.dst_type FROM anchors a JOIN align_ids i ON i.id=a.id ORDER BY a.id) TO STDOUT WITH(FORMAT text)
COPY (SELECT type_name,ancestor FROM graph_types ORDER BY type_name,ancestor) TO STDOUT WITH(FORMAT text)
COPY (SELECT user_id,doc::text FROM identity_users WHERE user_id='77ef1e57-4ce2-47c4-8616-451db58ce558') TO STDOUT WITH(FORMAT text)
SELECT count(*) FROM align_inputs
SELECT count(*) FROM align_friends
SELECT count(*) FROM align_forums
SELECT count(*) FROM align_posts
SELECT count(*) FROM align_edges
SELECT count(*) FROM align_ids
ROLLBACK
BEGIN
